GeometricTrace.actual_projection_order.{u_1} {H : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
  (V : Submodule ℂ H) [V.HasOrthogonalProjection] (A : H →L[ℂ] H) (hA : ∀ v ∈ V, A v ∈ V) :
  (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ H - V.starProjection).comp A =
    ((ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ H - V.starProjection).comp A).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ H - V.starProjection)
